== [.mon]#IV Mon.# June hath xxx days.

image::blank.svg[role=spacer,pdfwidth=1pt,pdfheight=8.53pt]

[.verse-line]
[.i153]##{nbsp}##‘Observe the daily circle of the sun,
[.i146]##{nbsp}##‘And the short year of each revolving moon:
[.i149]##{nbsp}##‘By them thou shalt foresee the following day,
[.i149]##{nbsp}##‘Nor shall a starry night thy hopes betray.
[.i144]##{nbsp}##‘When first the moon appears, if then she shrouds
[.i148]##{nbsp}##‘Her silver crescent, tip’d with sable clouds,
[.i146]##{nbsp}##‘Conclude she bodes a tempest on the main,
[.i146]##{nbsp}##‘And brews for fields impetuous floods of rain.
